purpose: Define autonomy as recursive self-application of the universal Evidence-Spiral resolver across causal depth and independent breadth until the frontier no longer carries under the declared evidence and authority boundaries.

recursion.depth: Apply the same resolver contract to every successor subproblem produced by the current exact subject.
recursion.breadth: Observe all causally independent subproblems on the same frontier and merge their read-only evidence deterministically.

termination.local_fixpoint: No node on the observed frontier has ACTION, REOBSERVE, HOLD, or REQUEST_AUTHORITY and no successor remains queued.
termination.open_frontier: At least one node still requires action, readback, authority, unresolved dependency resolution, or a declared resource bound was reached.

autonomy_rule: Continue recursively and breadth-wise whenever the exact current evidence exposes a causally justified successor within delegated authority. Stop only at a local fixpoint or a fail-closed open frontier whose blocker is explicit and bound.
self_application_rule: The resolver, its workflows, policies, receipts, and persistence mechanisms are themselves ordinary subjects of the same resolver and may not claim exemption from exact binding, readback, prevention, or successor semantics.
